name: HealthSpark Site Health Dashboard
author: Pluginjoy

sections.description:
HealthSpark gives you a complete health overview of your WordPress site in one beautiful dashboard. Stop juggling multiple plugins and tools — HealthSpark checks everything that matters and lets you fix issues with one click.

Five Vital Scans in One Dashboard

  • Accessibility (WCAG) — Missing alt text, heading hierarchy, skip links, theme accessibility, form labels, viewport zoom
  • Performance — Oversized images, page caching, PHP version, plugin count, post revisions, object cache
  • Security — WordPress updates, SSL, debug mode, file editor, admin username, database prefix, XML-RPC, plugin updates, file permissions
  • SEO Health — Search visibility, SEO plugin detection, XML sitemaps, permalinks, meta descriptions, thin content
  • EU Compliance — Privacy policy, cookie consent, data export tools, comment consent, data retention

One-Click Auto-Fixes

HealthSpark does not just find problems — it fixes them! Available auto-fixes include:

  • Generate alt text for images from filenames
  • Enable search engine visibility
  • Disable debug display for visitors
  • Enable comment cookie consent
  • Clean up spam and trash comments
  • Clean up old post revisions
  • Set SEO-friendly permalinks
  • Disable XML-RPC
  • Disable the file editor
  • Create a privacy policy page

Key Features

  • One-click scanning — Run all five scans with a single button
  • Beautiful dashboard — Clean, modern interface with color-coded scores
  • Actionable fixes — Direct links and auto-fix buttons for every issue
  • Score tracking — See your overall site health at a glance
  • Lightweight — No bloat, no external API calls in the free version
  • Translation ready — Fully prepared for localization
  • Smart detection — Recognizes any SEO, security, or cookie consent plugin

Pro Features

Unlock the full power of HealthSpark with Pro at pluginjoy.com:

  • Unlimited page scanning (free version: 5 pages)
  • Auto-fix accessibility issues
  • Cookie consent & GDPR compliance tools
  • PDF compliance reports
  • Scheduled automated scans
  • Email alerts when scores drop
  • White-label for agencies
  • CRA (Cyber Resilience Act) readiness checks
  • EAA (European Accessibility Act) audit
  • Priority support

sections.installation:
1. Upload the healthspark folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install directly from WordPress.org.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to HealthSpark in the admin sidebar.
  4. Click Run First Scan to check your site health.
sections.faq:
Does HealthSpark slow down my site?

No. HealthSpark only runs scans when you click the scan button or during scheduled background scans (Pro feature). It does not add any scripts or styles to your frontend.

Does it replace my SEO or security plugin?

No. HealthSpark is a health monitoring dashboard — it checks whether you have the right tools in place and identifies configuration issues. It works alongside your existing plugins.

My SEO plugin is not detected, why?

HealthSpark uses both exact plugin matching and smart detection. If your SEO plugin is not recognized, please let us know on the support forum and we will add it. The plugin also checks for SEO meta keys in your database as a fallback.

What is the difference between Free and Pro?

The free version scans your 5 most recent posts/pages and provides all five scan modules with one-click fixes. Pro unlocks unlimited scanning, auto-fixes for accessibility, PDF reports, scheduled scans, email alerts, and white-label options.

Does it comply with GDPR?

Yes. HealthSpark does not collect any personal data or send any data externally. All scan results are stored locally in your WordPress database.

Can I use this on client sites?

Yes. With Pro you can white-label the plugin and use it on unlimited client sites. The free version can be used on any site under the GPL license.
